_note: V20e, plan 01 §A journal contract, deterministic and model-free. Two planted read results over the same window and the same quality (supersession is per key since v2.6 plan 14 T0, 2306f8d3: a newer read only discards the older read's deltas for the keys it rewrites), handed to applyExtractionAudit (the entry point a shared read uses after its model call; the `extract` verb commits its own boundary, so it cannot hold two writes in the queue): the older is superseded and discarded at the boundary, the newer applied. The journal must link each read to its fate by audit id (not by equal delta strings), name the discarded write with its reason, show the queued write before the boundary, and journal a boundary that applied nothing. What it does NOT prove: a real model's read (the planted response stands in for it).

import_story.title: V20e journal contract
import_story.description: Two planted reads over the same turns: the older's key_taken is superseded by the newer's, its torch_seen still applies (per-key supersession).

qualities.rubric: Did the player take the brass key?
Has the player spotted the torch?
Has the vault door been crossed?

transitions.extraction_hint: Look for the key, the lamp and the door.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: true, cadence: 50 }); await SillyTavern.getContext().executeSlashCommandsWithOptions('/send I take the brass key, spot a torch and light the lamp.'); return { chatLength: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const to = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1; const audit = (id, q, evidence) => ({ id, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 1, reason: id, contractHash: 'v20e', scope: [q], window: { from: 0, to }, prompt: '', rawResponse: `DELTA ${q} value=true`, acceptedDeltas: [{ delta: { q, v: true, source: 'extractor' }, evidence }], rejected: [] }); const stamp = Date.now().toString(36); await rt.applyExtractionAudit(audit(`v20e-older-${stamp}`, 'lamp_lit', 'light the lamp'), []); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5)); await rt.applyExtractionAudit(audit(`v20e-newer-${stamp}`, 'lamp_lit', 'light the lamp'), []); return { boundary: rt.getSnapshot().boundary, audits: rt.getExtractionAudits().map((a) => a.id) };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const audits = rt.getExtractionAudits(); const older = audits.find((a) => a.reason.startsWith('v20e-older')); const newer = audits.find((a) => a.reason.startsWith('v20e-newer')); if (!older || !newer) throw new Error(`planted reads missing from the live audit ring: ${JSON.stringify(audits.map((a) => a.reason))}`); const queued = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((e) => e.detail?.state === 'queued'); const queuedOrigins = queued.map((e) => e.detail.origin); if (!queuedOrigins.includes(older.id) || !queuedOrigins.includes(newer.id)) throw new Error(`the queued writes are not linked to their reads: queued ${JSON.stringify(queuedOrigins)}, reads ${older.id} / ${newer.id}`); globalThis.__v20eReads = { older: older.id, newer: newer.id }; return { older: older.id, newer: newer.id, queued: queued.map((e) => e.summary) };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const reads = globalThis.__v20eReads; await rt.commitBoundary(); const journal = rt.getSessionJournal(); const row = journal.filter((e) => e.kind === 'boundary').at(-1); const applied = row?.detail?.applied ?? []; const discarded = row?.detail?.discarded ?? []; if (!applied.some((r) => r.origin === reads.newer && r.deltas.includes('lamp_lit=true'))) throw new Error(`the boundary does not link the applied write to its read ${reads.newer}: ${JSON.stringify(row)}`); const gone = discarded.find((r) => r.origin === reads.older); if (!gone || !gone.deltas.includes('lamp_lit=true') || !/superseded/.test(gone.reason ?? '')) throw new Error(`the discarded write is not named with its read and reason: ${JSON.stringify(discarded)}`); if (journal.some((e) => e.detail?.state === 'queued')) throw new Error('a write still reads as queued after the boundary drained it'); return { summary: row.summary, applied, discarded };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((e) => e.kind === 'boundary').length; await rt.commitBoundary(); const rows = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((e) => e.kind === 'boundary'); const last = rows.at(-1); if (rows.length !== before + 1 || !/nothing applied/.test(last?.summary ?? '')) throw new Error(`a boundary that applied nothing was not journaled: ${rows.length - before} new row(s), last ${JSON.stringify(last?.summary)}`); delete globalThis.__v20eReads; return { summary: last.summary };
